name: Family Bank Limited
source: kenyanstocks.com financial statements API (farmed) | FY2025: Family Bank Limited audited financial statements and other disclosures for the period ended 31 December 2025, GROUP column, PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP unqualified, https://familybank.co.ke/family-bank/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/FAMILY_BANK_LIMITED_Audited_Financial_Statement_and_Other_Disclosures_the_Period_31st_December_2025.pdf . Filing prints Shs 000, stored here in KES. Revenue is the statement's Total Operating Income (the bank's top line); Income Tax follows the file's existing convention (magnitude of current plus deferred tax). Operating Profit (EBIT) added as a derived row: total operating income less total operating expenses reproduces the printed profit before tax exactly for FY2023 (13,384,364 less 10,188,551 equals 3,195,813 thousand), FY2024 (3,916,337) and FY2025 (6,330,352, printed 6,330,351), so the bank has no items between operating profit and profit before tax. Family Bank prints no cost of sales and no gross profit line.
source_note: KShs'000 x1000 to absolute KES. Group figures. | EPS FY2024 read from Family-Bank-Ltd-Audited-Financial-Statements-Other-Disclosures-for-the-Period-Ended-31st-December-2024.pdf | EPS FY2023 read from Family-Bank-Ltd-Audited-Financial-Statements-Other-Disclosures-for-the-Period-Ended-31st-December-2024.pdf H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-fmly-2026-ir-hy/): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.
